name: Chilli Peanut Thecha Chutney
ingredients_raw: VEGETABLES* 40% [GREEN CHILLIES (24%), FRESHLY PEELED GARLIC (11%), CORIANDER PUREE], WATER, NUTS&PULSES (PEANUTS (15%), ROASTED BENGAL GRAM FLOUR], REFINED SOYABEAN OIL, SUGAR, IODISED SALT, SPICES &CONDIMENTS (RGASTED CUMIN POWDER (0.3%), SPICE EXTRACT, ONION POWDER, GINGER POWDER), ACETIC&CITRIC ACID, NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES, PRESERVATIVES (SODIUM BENZOATE), NATURAL FOOD COLOR (CHLOROPHYLL)
